		function decryptCharcode(n,start,end,offset) {
			n = n + offset;
			if (offset > 0 && n > end) {
				n = start + (n - end - 1);
			} else if (offset < 0 && n < start) {

		function decryptString(enc,offset) {
			var dec = "";
			var len = enc.length;
			for(var i=0; i < len; i++) {
				var n = enc.charCodeAt(i);
				if (n >= 0x2B && n <= 0x3A) {
					dec += decryptCharcode(n,0x2B,0x3A,offset);	/* 0-9 . , - + / : */

					dec += enc.charAt(i);

  ;(function () {
    const SECTION_SELECTOR = '#content-subscription-plans'
    const COLUMN_DEFAULT_SELECTOR = '.default-content'
    const COLUMN_NON_DEFAULT_SELECTOR = '.non-default-content'
    const DEVICES_SELECTOR = '.sppc-devices'

    const PRICE_SELECTOR = '.sppc-price-area .price:not(.obsolete)'
    const CENTS_SELECTOR = '.cents'
    const CURRENCY_SELECTOR = '.currency'
    const ADD_PACKAGE_SELECTOR = [
      '#content-add-package-text-1',
      '#content-add-package-text-2',
      '#content-add-package-text-3',
    ].join(', ')

    let isSyncing = false
    let priceUpdateFrame = null

    function getSection() {
      return document.querySelector(SECTION_SELECTOR)
    }

    function normalizeText(value) {
      return (value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase()
    }

    function findColumnForElement(startElement) {
      let element = startElement.parentElement

      while (element && element !== document.body) {
        const hasDefaultContent = element.querySelector(COLUMN_DEFAULT_SELECTOR)
        const hasNonDefaultContent = element.querySelector(COLUMN_NON_DEFAULT_SELECTOR)

        if (hasDefaultContent && hasNonDefaultContent) {
          return element
        }

        element = element.parentElement
      }

      return null
    }

    function getColumnDeviceGroups(column) {
      return Array.from(column.querySelectorAll(DEVICES_SELECTOR))
    }

    function getInteractiveElements(deviceGroup) {
      return Array.from(
        deviceGroup.querySelectorAll(
          'input, button, a, label, select, option, [role="button"], [data-value], [data-devices], [data-device]',
        ),
      )
    }

    function getSelectedDeviceValue(deviceGroup) {
      const select = deviceGroup.querySelector('select')

      if (select) {
        return {
          value: select.value,
          text: normalizeText(
            select.options[select.selectedIndex]
              ? select.options[select.selectedIndex].textContent
              : '',
          ),
        }
      }

      const checkedInput = deviceGroup.querySelector(
        'input[type="radio"]:checked, input[type="checkbox"]:checked',
      )

      if (checkedInput) {
        const label = checkedInput.id
          ? deviceGroup.querySelector('label[for="' + checkedInput.id + '"]')
          : null

        return {
          value: checkedInput.value,
          text: normalizeText(label ? label.textContent : checkedInput.textContent),
        }
      }

      const activeElement = deviceGroup.querySelector(
        '.active, .selected, .is-active, .is-selected, [aria-selected="true"], [aria-pressed="true"]',
      )

      if (activeElement) {
        return {
          value:
            activeElement.getAttribute('data-value') ||
            activeElement.getAttribute('data-devices') ||
            activeElement.getAttribute('data-device') ||
            activeElement.value ||
            normalizeText(activeElement.textContent),
          text: normalizeText(activeElement.textContent),
        }
      }

      return null
    }

    function elementMatchesDevice(element, selectedDevice) {
      if (!selectedDevice) {
        return false
      }

      const selectedValue = normalizeText(selectedDevice.value)
      const selectedText = normalizeText(selectedDevice.text)

      const candidates = [
        normalizeText(element.value),
        normalizeText(element.textContent),
        normalizeText(element.getAttribute('aria-label')),
        normalizeText(element.getAttribute('data-value')),
        normalizeText(element.getAttribute('data-devices')),
        normalizeText(element.getAttribute('data-device')),
      ].filter(Boolean)

      const href = normalizeText(element.getAttribute('href'))

      return (
        candidates.some(function (candidate) {
          return candidate === selectedValue || candidate === selectedText
        }) ||
        (selectedValue &&
          (href.indexOf('devices=' + selectedValue) !== -1 ||
            href.indexOf('device=' + selectedValue) !== -1))
      )
    }

    function triggerNativeEvents(element) {
      element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
      element.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
      element.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }))
    }

    function applyDeviceToGroup(deviceGroup, selectedDevice) {
      if (!selectedDevice) {
        return
      }

      const select = deviceGroup.querySelector('select')

      if (select) {
        const matchingOption = Array.from(select.options).find(function (option) {
          return elementMatchesDevice(option, selectedDevice)
        })

        if (matchingOption && select.value !== matchingOption.value) {
          select.value = matchingOption.value
          triggerNativeEvents(select)
        }

        return
      }

      const matchingElement = getInteractiveElements(deviceGroup).find(function (element) {
        return elementMatchesDevice(element, selectedDevice)
      })

      if (!matchingElement) {
        return
      }

      if (matchingElement.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        if (matchingElement.type === 'radio' || matchingElement.type === 'checkbox') {
          if (!matchingElement.checked) {
            matchingElement.checked = true
            triggerNativeEvents(matchingElement)
          }
        } else if (matchingElement.value !== selectedDevice.value) {
          matchingElement.value = selectedDevice.value
          triggerNativeEvents(matchingElement)
        }

        return
      }

      if (matchingElement.tagName === 'OPTION') {
        const parentSelect = matchingElement.closest('select')

        if (parentSelect && parentSelect.value !== matchingElement.value) {
          parentSelect.value = matchingElement.value
          triggerNativeEvents(parentSelect)
        }

        return
      }

      matchingElement.click()
    }

    function syncDevicesWithinColumn(sourceDeviceGroup) {
      if (isSyncing) {
        return
      }

      const column = findColumnForElement(sourceDeviceGroup)
      const selectedDevice = getSelectedDeviceValue(sourceDeviceGroup)

      if (!column || !selectedDevice) {
        return
      }

      const deviceGroups = getColumnDeviceGroups(column).filter(function (deviceGroup) {
        return deviceGroup !== sourceDeviceGroup
      })

      isSyncing = true

      try {
        deviceGroups.forEach(function (deviceGroup) {
          applyDeviceToGroup(deviceGroup, selectedDevice)
        })
      } finally {
        isSyncing = false
        schedulePackagePriceUpdate()
      }
    }

    function findWholeNumber(root) {
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT)
      const numberPattern = /\d{1,3}(?:(?:[ \u00a0.,'’]\d{3})+)|\d+/
      let textNode = walker.nextNode()

      while (textNode) {
        const parentElement = textNode.parentElement
        const shouldSkip =
          parentElement &&
          parentElement.closest(CENTS_SELECTOR + ', .sr-only, .visually-hidden, [hidden]')

        const match = !shouldSkip ? (textNode.nodeValue || '').match(numberPattern) : null

        if (match) {
          return { textNode: textNode, match: match }
        }

        textNode = walker.nextNode()
      }

      return null
    }

    function readPriceInCents(priceElement) {
      if (!priceElement) {
        return null
      }

      const centsElement = priceElement.querySelector(CENTS_SELECTOR)
      const wholeNumber = findWholeNumber(priceElement)

      if (!wholeNumber) {
        return null
      }

      const whole = Number.parseInt(wholeNumber.match[0].replace(/\D/g, ''), 10)
      const centsDigits = centsElement ? (centsElement.textContent || '').replace(/\D/g, '') : ''
      const cents = centsDigits ? Number.parseInt(centsDigits, 10) % 100 : 0

      return whole * 100 + cents
    }

    function setCentsText(centsElement, cents) {
      const sourceText = centsElement.textContent || ''

      if (/\d+/.test(sourceText)) {
        centsElement.textContent = sourceText.replace(/\d+/, cents)
      } else {
        centsElement.textContent = '.' + cents
      }
    }

    function replaceWholeNumber(priceClone, whole, isNegative) {
      const wholeNumber = findWholeNumber(priceClone)

      if (!wholeNumber) {
        return false
      }

      const sourceText = wholeNumber.textNode.nodeValue || ''
      const replacement = (isNegative ? '-' : '') + String(whole)

      wholeNumber.textNode.nodeValue =
        sourceText.slice(0, wholeNumber.match.index) +
        replacement +
        sourceText.slice(wholeNumber.match.index + wholeNumber.match[0].length)

      return true
    }

    function copyExternalCurrency(sourcePrice, priceClone) {
      if (priceClone.querySelector(CURRENCY_SELECTOR)) {
        return
      }

      const priceArea = sourcePrice.closest('.sppc-price-area')
      const currencyElement = priceArea
        ? Array.from(priceArea.querySelectorAll(CURRENCY_SELECTOR)).find(function (element) {
            return !element.closest('.price')
          })
        : null

      if (!currencyElement) {
        return
      }

      const currencyIsBefore =
        currencyElement.compareDocumentPosition(sourcePrice) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING

      if (currencyIsBefore) {
        priceClone.prepend(currencyElement.cloneNode(true))
      } else {
        priceClone.append(currencyElement.cloneNode(true))
      }
    }

    function renderPriceDifference(target, differenceInCents, sourcePrice) {
      const absoluteDifference = Math.abs(differenceInCents)
      const whole = Math.floor(absoluteDifference / 100)
      const cents = String(absoluteDifference % 100).padStart(2, '0')
      const priceClone = sourcePrice.cloneNode(true)
      let centsElement = priceClone.querySelector(CENTS_SELECTOR)

      if (!centsElement) {
        centsElement = document.createElement('span')
        centsElement.className = 'cents'
        priceClone.append(centsElement)
      }

      setCentsText(centsElement, cents)

      if (!replaceWholeNumber(priceClone, whole, differenceInCents < 0)) {
        return
      }

      copyExternalCurrency(sourcePrice, priceClone)

      // Do <u> vložíme obsah aktívnej ceny, nie ďalší wrapper .price.
      if (target.innerHTML !== priceClone.innerHTML) {
        target.innerHTML = priceClone.innerHTML
      }
    }

    function getPlanColumns(section) {
      const columns = []

      section.querySelectorAll(DEVICES_SELECTOR).forEach(function (deviceGroup) {
        const column = findColumnForElement(deviceGroup)

        if (column && column !== section && columns.indexOf(column) === -1) {
          columns.push(column)
        }
      })

      return columns
    }

    function getPackageColumn(packageElement, index, columns, section) {
      const directColumn = findColumnForElement(packageElement)

      if (directColumn && directColumn !== section) {
        return directColumn
      }

      const idMatch = packageElement.id.match(/content-add-package-(\d+)/)
      const columnIndex = idMatch ? Number.parseInt(idMatch[1], 10) - 1 : index

      return columns[columnIndex] || null
    }

    function updatePackagePrices() {
      const section = getSection()

      if (!section) {
        return
      }

      const columns = getPlanColumns(section)

      Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(ADD_PACKAGE_SELECTOR)).forEach(
        function (packageElement, index) {
          const column = getPackageColumn(packageElement, index, columns, section)
          const target = packageElement.matches('u')
            ? packageElement
            : packageElement.querySelector('u')

          if (!column || !target) {
            return
          }

          const defaultPrice = column.querySelector(COLUMN_DEFAULT_SELECTOR + ' ' + PRICE_SELECTOR)
          const nonDefaultPrice = column.querySelector(
            COLUMN_NON_DEFAULT_SELECTOR + ' ' + PRICE_SELECTOR,
          )

          const defaultPriceInCents = readPriceInCents(defaultPrice)
          const nonDefaultPriceInCents = readPriceInCents(nonDefaultPrice)

          if (defaultPriceInCents === null || nonDefaultPriceInCents === null) {
            return
          }

          renderPriceDifference(
            target,
            nonDefaultPriceInCents - defaultPriceInCents,
            nonDefaultPrice,
          )
        },
      )
    }

    function schedulePackagePriceUpdate() {
      if (priceUpdateFrame !== null) {
        return
      }

      priceUpdateFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        priceUpdateFrame = null
        updatePackagePrices()
      })
    }

    function mutationTouchesPrice(mutation) {
      const targetElement =
        mutation.target.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE
          ? mutation.target
          : mutation.target.parentElement

      if (targetElement && targetElement.closest('.sppc-price-area')) {
        return true
      }

      return Array.from(mutation.addedNodes || []).some(function (node) {
        return (
          node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE &&
          (node.matches('.sppc-price-area') || Boolean(node.querySelector('.sppc-price-area')))
        )
      })
    }

    function observePriceChanges(section) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
        if (mutations.some(mutationTouchesPrice)) {
          schedulePackagePriceUpdate()
        }
      })

      observer.observe(section, {
        subtree: true,
        childList: true,
        characterData: true,
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class'],
      })
    }

    function bindDeviceGroup(deviceGroup) {
      if (deviceGroup.getAttribute('data-sppc-devices-sync-bound') === 'true') {
        return
      }

      deviceGroup.setAttribute('data-sppc-devices-sync-bound', 'true')

      deviceGroup.addEventListener('change', function () {
        syncDevicesWithinColumn(deviceGroup)
      })

      deviceGroup.addEventListener('click', function () {
        window.setTimeout(function () {
          syncDevicesWithinColumn(deviceGroup)
        }, 0)
      })
    }

    function initDeviceSync() {
      const section = getSection()

      if (!section) {
        return
      }

      Array.from(section.querySelectorAll(DEVICES_SELECTOR)).forEach(bindDeviceGroup)
      observePriceChanges(section)
      schedulePackagePriceUpdate()
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initDeviceSync)
    } else {
      initDeviceSync()
    }
  })()

  ;(function () {

    }

    function normalizeText(value) {

    }

    function renderYearSwitchLabels(switchElement) {
      YEAR_OPTIONS.forEach(function (item) {
        const label = switchElement.querySelector(
          'label[for="sppc-year-switch-' + item.value + '"]',

        if (!label) {

        const textElement = document.createElement('span')
        textElement.className = 'sppc-year-switch-text'
        textElement.textContent = item.label

        label.appendChild(textElement)

          const pillElement = document.createElement('span')

          pillElement.className = 'sppc-year-switch-pill'

    function updateYearSwitchWidth(switchElement) {

      const labels = Array.from(switchElement.querySelectorAll('.sppc-year-switch-label'))

      if (!yearSwitch || !labels.length) {

      yearSwitch.classList.remove('sppc-year-switch-stacked')
      yearSwitch.style.removeProperty('--sppc-year-switch-item-width')

      let widestLabel = labels.reduce(function (maxWidth, label) {
        return Math.max(maxWidth, label.getBoundingClientRect().width)
      }, 0)

      if (!widestLabel) {
        return
      }

      const requiredWidth = Math.ceil(widestLabel) * labels.length + 2

      if (requiredWidth > switchElement.clientWidth) {
        yearSwitch.classList.add('sppc-year-switch-stacked')

        widestLabel = labels.reduce(function (maxWidth, label) {
          return Math.max(maxWidth, label.getBoundingClientRect().width)
